title: "Plugin: publisher-crates"
description: Publishes Rust crates to crates.io using cargo publish after semrel computes the release version.
---

<!-- This code has been fully generated by an AI. -->

Publishes Rust crates to [crates.io](https://crates.io) by running `cargo publish` after semrel has determined and applied the release version. Supports single crates as well as ordered Cargo workspace members.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/publisher-crates
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.

### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/publisher-crates:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/publisher-crates:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/publisher-crates/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/updater-cargo
    phase: pre-tag
    args:
      file: Cargo.toml

  - uses: @semrel/publisher-crates
    phase: release
    args:
      cargo_registry_token: '${env.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN}'
      cargo_workspace_member: "crate-core,crate-cli"
      cargo_manifest_path: Cargo.toml
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN` | yes (unless dry-run) | `—` | crates.io API token passed to Cargo via `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN` (never on the command line). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_WORKSPACE_MEMBER` | no | default package | Comma-separated workspace members to publish in order (`cargo publish --package <name>`). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_PACKAGE` | no | `—` | Alias for `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_WORKSPACE_MEMBER`. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_MANIFEST_PATH` | no | `Cargo.toml` | Manifest path passed as `cargo publish --manifest-path <path>`. |

## Release Context Variables

- `SEMREL_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_DRY_RUN`

## Behavior

- Requires `cargo` on `$PATH`.
- Publishes workspace members in the exact order specified and aborts on the first failure.
- In dry-run mode (`SEMREL_DRY_RUN=true`), executes `cargo publish --dry-run` to validate crate packaging without uploading to crates.io.
